forkChangesPreserved: T3 Pretty mobile builds continue deriving their Expo app version from T3CODE_MOBILE_APP_VERSION or the fork release train, while normalizing prerelease versions for iOS compatibility.

upstreamChangesOmitted.change: Bump the parent mobile app's static Expo version from 1.0.3 to 1.0.4.
upstreamChangesOmitted.reason: T3 Pretty intentionally replaced the parent's static mobile version with resolveMobileAppVersion(), which tracks the fork's release train and produces an iOS-compatible numeric version. Applying the parent static value would regress fork release/version identity.
